info.description: Published controls for robots.txt, sitemap.xml and llms.txt. URLs come from published page content.

allowIndexing.description: Also requires SITE_INDEXING_ALLOWED=true in deployment. Dev/UAT always block crawling.

llmsTitle.description: Blank inherits the published site name.

llmsSummary.description: Short summary displayed as the llms.txt blockquote. Blank inherits site SEO description.

llmsGuidance.description: Optional Markdown guidance, e.g. booking and membership context.

excludedPaths.description: One local path per line, excluded from both sitemap and llms. A trailing / excludes the entire subtree. Does not restrict access.
